# `csharp_wrap_arguments_style`

chop_always gives every argument its own line. Only honoured in deterministic mode (max_line_length set).

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `chop_always` |  |
| `chop_if_long` |  |

**Default:** `chop_if_long`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Register(string name, int value, bool active, string tag)
    {
    }

    public void Run()
    {
        Register("kerf", 42, true, "formatter");
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_arguments_style = chop_always`

```editorconfig
csharp_wrap_arguments_style = chop_always
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Register(string name, int value, bool active, string tag)
    {
    }

    public void Run()
    {
        Register(
            "kerf",
            42,
            true,
            "formatter"
        );
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_arguments_style = chop_if_long`

```editorconfig
csharp_wrap_arguments_style = chop_if_long
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
